title: SaaS firm Freshworks to acquire Torii to expand AI and software spend management
key_facts: Freshworks, a Nasdaq-listed business software company, signed an agreement to buy Torii, a software management platform.
Announced 12 Oct; expected to close in Freshworks' fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, subject to usual conditions.
The deal adds tracking of software licences, access and AI spending to Freshworks' IT service product, Freshservice.
Torii can track AI use at the token level, attribute it to teams and set spending limits.
Freshworks CEO Dennis Woodside said IT teams are asked to govern more with less visibility into cost.
Torii customers include Hearst, Groupon and Koch; no price is given in the part read.
quote_evidence: Nasdaq-listed SaaS company Freshworks has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Torii, a SaaS management platform.
The acquisition, announced on 12 October, is expected to close in Freshworks' fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.
why_it_matters_hint: Companies are buying tools to control the growing cost of AI use.
notes: Deal terms and price not seen in the text read.
